{"consolidated_memory":"**401 Storm Issues in services/auth/token_refresh.py — Two Occasions**

**Component:** services/auth/token_refresh.py (authentication side)
**Test coverage:** tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py
**Common repro pattern:** let an access token expire mid-session
**Common signal:** burst of unauthorized responses in the access log

---

**OCCASION 1 [2026-03-06]**
- **Trigger condition:** Only when the input list came in empty
- **Root cause:** N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Fix:** Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR #1566 on branch fix/401-storm-1**
- **Measured outcome:** Error rate dropped from 5.9 percent to under 3 per ten thousand

**OCCASION 2 [2026-08-11]**
- **Trigger condition:** Only on the staging read replica
- **Root cause:** Clock skew between the two hosts
- **Fix:** Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- **PR #6913 on branch fix/401-storm-2**
- **Measured outcome:** Throughput rose 79 percent, to 67 requests per second
- **Note:** Same corner of services/auth/token_refresh.py as the first incident; context carried over from the earlier fix"}
